description: Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa) is an open data portal listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Government of Qatar (National Planning Council). The Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa) is the national open data portal of Qatar, run on Opendatasoft. It lists about 1,900 data sets, most of them statistical tables of the National Planning Council, with operational series from the electricity and water utility KAHRAMAA, the public works authority Ashghal, the Civil Aviation Authority and ministries. Coverage: Qatar. 1,921 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 109 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
